description: Noise kinds understood by v3lum.core.noise. The built-in core lists live in v3lum/core/noise.py (_CORE); data fragments in this directory (schema v3lum.noise/1) add more lists. This file only documents the kinds.

kinds.cdn: content delivery networks and edge caches (Cloudflare, Akamai, Fastly, CloudFront...): one address serves thousands of unrelated sites; is_cdn() is True
kinds.cloud: public cloud provider infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud...); is_cdn() is True
kinds.webmail: consumer mailbox providers: the domain is noise, an address at it is a person and never noise
kinds.hosting: shared web/DNS hosting, registrar name servers and site builders; is_cdn() is True
kinds.saas: large platforms and SaaS front doors (Google, Microsoft 365, Dropbox, mail delivery services, form/share short links); is_cdn() is True
kinds.sinkhole: sinkholed infrastructure operated by researchers or registries: a resolution to it is a lead (is_sinkhole), pivoting on it is not
kinds.parked: domain parking services and their name servers: tags the domain as parked (is_parked)
kinds.benign_scanner: known benign internet-wide scanners (research scanners): their hits in logs are background noise
kinds.warninglist: a named warninglist (MISP warninglist style): values are listed but not auto-pivoted and their malicious findings become 'POSSIBLE - on warninglist <name>'; not noise for is_noise()
kinds.private: computed: private, loopback, reserved, multicast and link-local addresses (never listed in fragments)
